settings.editor: Most teams connect their first source in under ten minutes. Signalry starts finding themes as soon as feedback arrives, and the first weekly summary is ready the following Monday.

settings._title: Which tools does Signalry connect to?

settings.editor: Help desks, live chat, survey tools, CRMs, app stores and call recorders. You can also upload a CSV or forward emails to your Signalry inbox.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, stored in the region you choose, and never used to train shared models. SSO and audit logs come with every paid plan.

settings.custom_css: selector{box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(14,21,37,.35)}selector .wpcf7-form{display:grid;gap:16px}selector .wpcf7-form p{margin:0}selector .form__row{display:grid;gap:16px}@media (min-width:640px){selector .form__row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}selector label{display:block;color:#0E1525;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4}selector .wpcf7-form-control-wrap{display:block;margin-top:6px}selector input[type=text],selector input[type=email],selector select,selector textarea{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #cfd5e1;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#0E1525;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}selector textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}selector input:focus,selector select:focus,selector textarea:focus{border-color:#3D5AFE;outline:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #E9EDFF}selector .form__consent .wpcf7-list-item{margin:0}selector .form__consent label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;color:#6B7487;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}selector .form__consent input{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;margin:2px 0 0;accent-color:#3D5AFE}selector .wpcf7-submit{width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:0 22px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#3D5AFE;color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s}selector .wpcf7-submit:hover{background:#2238C9}@media (max-width:767px){selector .wpcf7-submit{min-height:48px;font-size:15px}}selector .wpcf7-spinner{position:absolute}selector .wpcf7-response-output{margin:0;font-size:14px}
